cards.card_text: Then the LORD of Hosts says, "Then I will draw near to you for judgment." He will be a witness against sorcerers, adulterers, perjurers and those who oppress the widowed and fatherless.
cards.verse_text: And I will be a swift witness against sorcerers and adulterers and perjurers, against oppressors of the widowed and fatherless, and against those who defraud laborers of their wages and deny justice to the foreigner but do not fear Me,” says the LORD of Hosts.
